dedupe_keys.name: dataset of energyplus models to evaluate the impact of modeling the hysteresis phenomenon of phase change materials on the building energy performance

description: A TU Darmstadt researcher publishes five EnergyPlus input models for a medium office and a Frankfurt typical-meteorological-year weather file. Zenodo lists individual IDF and EPW files under CC BY 4.0. One office file is the baseline and four vary the phase-change-material representation: melting curve, solidification curve, mean curve and hysteresis model. The package can test how material-state assumptions change simulated heating, cooling and thermal storage performance. Related catalogue model-energyplus is the software required to run these inputs. Coverage is the medium-office archetype and Frankfurt weather case, not all building types or climates. A limitation is that the comparison isolates a material-model choice; any performance difference also depends on the chosen office construction, schedules and weather. The own page does not provide measured validation for every scenario. No model file was downloaded, EnergyPlus was not run, and reported performance effects were not reproduced.
